description: Turn a finished DOCX into a template: the model proposes which literal values should become fields, those spans are rewritten as markers, and a manifest is embedded. Returns the prepared DOCX as base64 with the field count and how many suggestions could not be applied, for review before it is stored as a template. Unlike templates.fields.suggest this rewrites the document. Consumes AI usage.

alternative.reason: the model marks fields in the supplied document's own bytes; there is no stored-document equivalent
